title: 不善寻思
note: 欲寻、嗔寻、害寻；五法止息杂念

evidence.pali: 221 . ‘‘Yato kho yato ca kho (syā. ka.) , bhikkhave, bhikkhuno yaṃ nimittaṃ āgamma yaṃ nimittaṃ manasikaroto uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā vitakkā chandūpasaṃhitāpi dosūpasaṃhitāpi mohūpasaṃhitāpi, tassa tamhā nimittā aññaṃ nimittaṃ manasikaroto kusalūpasaṃhitaṃ ye pāpakā akusalā vitakkā chandūpasaṃhitāpi dosūpasaṃhitāpi mohūpasaṃhitāpi te pahīyanti te abbhatthaṃ gacchanti. Tesaṃ pahānā ajjhattameva cittaṃ santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodi hoti samādhiyati. Tesampi vitakkānaṃ ādīnavaṃ upaparikkhato ye pāpakā akusalā vitakkā chandūpasaṃhitāpi dosūpasaṃhitāpi mohūpasaṃhitāpi te pahīyanti te abbhatthaṃ gacchanti. Tesaṃ pahānā ajjhattameva cittaṃ santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodi hoti samādhiyati. Tesampi vitakkānaṃ asatiamanasikāraṃ āpajjato ye pāpakā akusalā vitakkā chandūpasaṃhitāpi dosūpasaṃhitāpi mohūpasaṃhitāpi te pahīyanti te abbhatthaṃ gacchanti. Tesaṃ pahānā ajjhattameva cittaṃ santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodi hoti samādhiyati. Tesampi vitakkānaṃ vitakkasaṅkhārasaṇṭhānaṃ manasikaroto ye pāpakā akusalā vitakkā chandūpasaṃhitāpi dosūpasaṃhitāpi mohūpasaṃhitāpi te pahīyanti te abbhatthaṃ gacchanti. Tesaṃ pahānā ajjhattameva cittaṃ santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodi hoti samādhiyati. Dantebhidantamādhāya jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca cetasā cittaṃ abhiniggaṇhato abhinippīḷayato abhisantāpayato ye pāpakā akusalā vitakkā chandūpasaṃhitāpi dosūpasaṃhitāpi mohūpasaṃhitāpi te pahīyanti te abbhatthaṃ gacchanti. Tesaṃ pahānā ajjhattameva cittaṃ santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodi hoti samādhiyati. Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vasī vitakkapariyāyapathesu. Yaṃ vitakkaṃ ākaṅkhissati taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakkessati, yaṃ vitakkaṃ nākaṅkhissati na taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakkessati. Acchecchi taṇhaṃ, vivattayi vāvattayi (sī. pī.) saṃyojanaṃ, sammā mānābhisamayā antamakāsi dukkhassā’’ti.
evidence.chinese_simplified: 221. “诸比丘，当一位比丘由于某个相，作意某个相时，生起与贪、嗔、痴相应的恶不善寻，他从那个相转向作意另一个与善相应的相时，那些与贪、嗔、痴相应的恶不善寻就被舍弃，它们就消失了。由于舍弃了它们，其心就在内安住、沉静、成为一境、得等持。当他省察那些寻的过患时，那些与贪、嗔、痴相应的恶不善寻就被舍弃，它们就消失了。由于舍弃了它们，其心就在内安住、沉静、成为一境、得等持。当他不去忆念、不作意那些寻时，那些与贪、嗔、痴相应的恶不善寻就被舍弃，它们就消失了。由于舍弃了它们，其心就在内安住、沉静、成为一境、得等持。当他作意那些寻行之止息时，那些与贪、嗔、痴相应的恶不善寻就被舍弃，它们就消失了。由于舍弃了它们，其心就在内安住、沉静、成为一境、得等持。当他以齿咬齿，以舌抵颚，以心抑制、压伏、折磨其心时，那些与贪、嗔、痴相应的恶不善寻就被舍弃，它们就消失了。由于舍弃了它们，其心就在内安住、沉静、成为一境、得等持。诸比丘，这称为于寻的各种转向得自在的比丘。他想寻思什么寻，就能寻思那个寻；他不想寻思什么寻，就不寻思那个寻。他已斩断渴爱，断除结缚，通过正遍知慢而终结了苦。”
evidence.english: 221. O monks, when evil, unwholesome thoughts connected with desire, aversion, or delusion arise in a monk attending to a certain sign, then for that monk, by attending to another sign connected with the wholesome, those evil, unwholesome thoughts connected with desire, aversion, or delusion are abandoned; they go to cessation. Due to their abandonment, the mind becomes steady internally, settles down, becomes unified, and is concentrated. For him who investigates the danger of those very thoughts, those evil, unwholesome thoughts connected with desire, aversion, or delusion are abandoned; they go to cessation. Due to their abandonment, the mind becomes steady internally, settles down, becomes unified, and is concentrated. For him who attains non-recollection and non-attention towards those very thoughts, those evil, unwholesome thoughts connected with desire, aversion, or delusion are abandoned; they go to cessation. Due to their abandonment, the mind becomes steady internally, settles down, becomes unified, and is concentrated. For him who attends to the causal basis of the formation of those very thoughts, those evil, unwholesome thoughts connected with desire, aversion, or delusion are abandoned; they go to cessation. Due to their abandonment, the mind becomes steady internally, settles down, becomes unified, and is concentrated. For that monk who, placing tooth upon tooth, pressing his tongue against the palate, restrains, crushes, and afflicts the mind with the mind, those evil, unwholesome thoughts connected with desire, aversion, or delusion are abandoned; they go to cessation. Due to their abandonment, the mind becomes steady internally, settles down, becomes unified, and is concentrated. This, O monks, is called a monk who is a master in the paths of the courses of thought. Whatever thought he wishes to think, that thought he will think; whatever thought he does not wish to think, that thought he will not think. He has cut off craving, turned away the fetter, and by the right full understanding of conceit, has made an end of suffering.

entries.work_title: 分别论义注迷惑冰消 Sammohavinodanī-Aṭṭhakathā
entries.pali: Chandarāgo ti evaṃ akusalavitakkena vitakkite vatthusmiṃ dubbalarāgo ca balavarāgo ca uppajjati. Idañhi idha chando ti dubbalarāgassādhivacanaṃ . Ajjhosāna nti ahaṃ mamanti balavasanniṭṭhānaṃ. Pariggaho ti taṇhādiṭṭhivasena pariggahakaraṇaṃ. Macchariya nti parehi sādhāraṇabhāvassa asahanatā. Tenevassa porāṇā evaṃ vacanatthaṃ vadanti – ‘‘idaṃ acchariyaṃ mayhameva hotu, mā aññassa acchariyaṃ hotūti pavattattā macchariyanti vuccatī’’ti. Ārakkho ti dvārapidahanamañjusagopanādivasena suṭṭhu rakkhaṇaṃ. Adhikarotīti adhikaraṇaṃ; kāraṇassetaṃ nāmaṃ. Ārakkhādhikaraṇa nti bhāvanapuṃsakaṃ; ārakkhahetūti attho. Daṇḍādānādīsu paranisedhanatthaṃ daṇḍassa ādānaṃ daṇḍādānaṃ . Ekatodhārādino satthassa ādānaṃ satthādānaṃ. Kalaho ti kāyakalahopi vācākalahopi. Purimo purimo virodho viggaho, pacchimo pacchimo vivādo. Tuvaṃ tuva nti agāravavacanaṃ, tvaṃ tvanti attho.
entries.chinese_simplified: 贪欲(chandarāgo)，是依不善寻思对境作意时，生起弱贪与强贪。此处所谓欲(chando)，即是弱贪的同义词。执取(ajjhosānaṃ)，是“我、我所”的坚固执著。占有(pariggaho)，是以渴爱和邪见的方式进行占有。悭吝(macchariyaṃ)，是不能忍受与他人共有。古人即解释此词义云：“此珍奇物唯当属我，莫令他人得到珍奇物，由此生起故称悭吝”。守护(ārakkho)，是以闭门、封箱、善藏等方式严密守护。争讼(adhikaraṇaṃ)，这是事由之名。因守护起争讼(ārakkhādhikaraṇaṃ)是中性词，意为守护之因。执杖(daṇḍādānaṃ)，是为了禁止他人而执持刀杖。执剑(satthādānaṃ)，是执持单锋武器等利器。斗诤(kalaho)，或是身体上的斗争，或是言语上的斗争。前前的抵触为纷争，后后的争论为诤讼。“尔尔”(tuvaṃ tuvaṃ)是不敬语，意即“你你”。
entries.english: ‘Desire-lust’ (chandarāga) arises in an object that has been thought upon with unwholesome thought; both weak lust and strong lust arise. For here, ‘desire’ (chanda) is a designation for weak lust. ‘Clinging’ (ajjhosāna) is the strong conviction of ‘I’ and ‘mine.’ ‘Possessiveness’ (pariggaha) is the act of possessing through craving and views. ‘Stinginess’ (macchariya) is the inability to tolerate sharing with others. Therefore, the ancients explain the meaning of the term thus: ‘Because it arises with the thought, “Let this precious thing be mine alone, and not belong to another,” it is called stinginess.’ ‘Guarding’ (ārakkha) means thorough protection, such as barring doors, concealing valuables in chests, and the like. That which is made an issue is a ‘cause’ (adhikaraṇa); this is a name for a cause. ‘Guarding as a cause’ (ārakkhādhikaraṇa) is an abstract neuter noun; the meaning is ‘because of guarding.’ ‘Taking up the rod’ (daṇḍādāna) means taking up a stick for the purpose of restraining others. ‘Taking up a weapon’ (satthādāna) means taking up a single-edged blade or the like. ‘Quarreling’ (kalaha) refers to both physical conflict and verbal conflict. The former is opposition and strife; the latter is contention. ‘You, you’ (tuvaṃ tuvaṃ) is a disrespectful way of speaking; the meaning is ‘you, you.’

entries.pali: Chandarāgo ti evaṃ akusalavitakkena vitakkitavatthusmiṃ dubbalarāgo ca balavarāgo ca uppajjati, idañhi idha taṇhā. Chando ti dubbalarāgassādhivacanaṃ. Ajjhosāna nti ahaṃ mamanti balavasanniṭṭhānaṃ. Pariggaho ti taṇhādiṭṭhavasena pariggahaṇakaraṇaṃ. Macchariya nti parehi sādhāraṇabhāvassa asahanatā. Tenevassa porāṇā evaṃ vacanatthaṃ vadanti – ‘‘idaṃ acchariyaṃ mayhameva hotu, mā aññesaṃ acchariyaṃ hotūti pavattattā macchariyanti vuccatī’’ti. Ārakkho ti dvārapidahanamañjūsagopanādivasena suṭṭhu rakkhaṇaṃ. Adhikarotīti adhikaraṇaṃ, kāraṇassetaṃ nāmaṃ. Ārakkhādhikaraṇa nti bhāvanapuṃsakaṃ, ārakkhahetūti attho. Daṇḍādānādīsu paranisedhanatthaṃ daṇḍassa ādānaṃ daṇḍādānaṃ. Ekato dhārādino satthassa ādānaṃ satthādānaṃ. Kalaho ti kāyakalahopi vācākalahopi. Purimo purimo virodho viggaho. Pacchimo pacchimo vivādo. Tuvaṃtuvanti agāravavacanaṃ tuvaṃtuvaṃ.
entries.chinese_simplified: 所谓‘欲贪’(chandarāga)，即是如此，在由不善寻思所思惟之事中，生起微弱之贪与强烈之贪，于此（经）中，此即是渴爱(taṇhā)。‘欲’(chanda)是微弱之贪的异名。‘耽著’(ajjhosāna)是“我”和“我所”的强烈认定。‘执取’(pariggaha)是以贪和见为力而进行的占据。‘悭’(macchariya)是不能容忍与他人共有。因此古人如此解释其词义：‘因“愿此珍奇之物仅为我所有，勿为他人有”之念转起，故称为悭。’‘守护’(ārakkha)是指通过关门、锁箱等方式妥善地守护。因为它能引生（结果），所以称为‘因缘’(adhikaraṇa)；这是‘原因’(kāraṇa)的异名。‘守护为因’(ārakkhādhikaraṇa)是中性语态词，意思是‘因守护故’。于‘执杖’(daṇḍādāna)等词中，为禁止他人而拿起棍杖，是为‘执杖’。拿起单刃刀等武器，是为‘执刀’(satthādāna)。‘争吵’(kalaha)既有身体的争吵，也有语言的争吵。最初的对立是‘争斗’(viggaha)，最终的对立是‘诤论’(vivāda)。‘你你’(tuvaṃtuvaṃ)是不敬之言。
entries.english: 'Desire-lust' (chandarāga): thus, in regard to an object conceived with unwholesome thought, both weak lust and strong lust arise; for this here is craving. 'Desire' (chanda) is a designation for weak lust. 'Tenacity' (ajjhosāna) is the strong conviction, 'I,' 'mine.' 'Appropriation' (pariggaha) is the act of taking possession by means of craving and views. 'Stinginess' (macchariya) is the inability to bear something being shared with others. For this reason, the ancients state its etymology thus: 'Because it occurs with the thought, "Let this marvel be for me alone, let it not be a marvel for others," it is called stinginess.' 'Guarding' (ārakkha) is protecting well by means of barring doors, securing chests, and so on. Because it is a basis for results (adhikaroti), it is called a 'ground' (adhikaraṇa); this is a name for a cause. The term 'on account of guarding' (ārakkhādhikaraṇa) is a neuter abstract noun; the meaning is 'due to the cause of guarding.' In the terms beginning with 'taking up the rod' (daṇḍādāna), the taking up of a rod to obstruct another is 'taking up the rod.' The taking up of a weapon, such as a single-edged blade, is 'taking up the weapon.' 'Conflict' (kalaha) is both bodily conflict and verbal conflict. An earlier stage of opposition is a 'quarrel' (viggaha). A later stage is a 'dispute' (vivāda). 'You-you' (tuvaṃtuvaṃ) is a disrespectful expression.

entries.pali: ‘‘Taṇhaṃ paṭicca pariyesanā, pariyesanaṃ paṭicca lābho, lābhaṃ paṭicca vinicchayo, vinicchayaṃ paṭicca chandarāgo, chandarāgaṃ paṭicca ajjhosānaṃ, ajjhosānaṃ paṭicca pariggaho, pariggahaṃ paṭicca macchariyaṃ, macchariyaṃ paṭicca ārakkho, ārakkhādhikaraṇaṃ daṇḍādānasatthādānakalahaviggahavivādatuvaṃtuvaṃpesuññamusāvādā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavantī’’ti (dī. ni. 2.103; 3.359) evamāgatā pariyesanādayo nava taṇhāmūlakā . Tattha (dī. ni. aṭṭha. 2.103) taṇhaṃ paṭiccā ti taṇhaṃ nissāya. Pariyesanā ti rūpādiārammaṇapariyesanā. Sā hi taṇhāya sati hoti. Lābho ti rūpādiārammaṇapaṭilābho. So hi pariyesanāya sati hoti. Vinicchayo ti idha vitakko adhippeto. Lābhaṃ labhitvā hi iṭṭhāniṭṭhaṃ sundarāsundarañca vitakkeneva vinicchinati ‘‘ettakaṃ me rūpārammaṇatthāya bhavissati, ettakaṃ saddādiārammaṇatthāya, ettakaṃ mayhaṃ bhavissati, ettakaṃ parassa, ettakaṃ paribhuñjissāmi, ettakaṃ nidahissāmī’’ti. Tena vuttaṃ ‘‘lābhaṃ paṭicca vinicchayo’’ti. Chandarāgo ti evaṃ akusalavitakkena vitakkite vatthusmiṃ dubbalarāgo ca balavarāgo ca uppajjati. Chando ti hi idha dubbalarāgassādhivacanaṃ. Ajjhosāna nti ahaṃ mamanti balavasanniṭṭhānaṃ. Pariggaho ti taṇhādiṭṭhivasena pariggahakaraṇaṃ. Macchariya nti parehi sādhāraṇabhāvassa asahanatā. Tenevassa porāṇā evaṃ vacanatthaṃ vadanti ‘‘idaṃ acchariyaṃ mayhameva hotu, mā aññassa acchariyaṃ hotūti pavattattā macchariyanti vuccatī’’ti. Ārakkho ti dvārapidahanamañjusagopanādivasena suṭṭhu rakkhaṇaṃ. Adhikarotīti adhikaraṇaṃ, kāraṇassetaṃ nāmaṃ. Ārakkhādhikaraṇa nti bhāvanapuṃsakaṃ, ārakkhahetūti attho. Daṇḍādānādīsu paranisedhanatthaṃ daṇḍassa ādānaṃ daṇḍādānaṃ . Ekatodhārādino satthassa ādānaṃ satthādānaṃ. Kalaho ti kāyakalahopi vācākalahopi. Purimo purimo virodho viggaho . Pacchimo pacchimo vivādo . Tuvaṃ tuva nti agāravavacanaṃ, tvaṃ tvanti attho.
entries.chinese_simplified: “缘于渴爱有寻求，缘于寻求有获得，缘于获得有抉择，缘于抉择有欲贪，缘于欲贪有耽著，缘于耽著有执持，缘于执持有悭吝，缘于悭吝有守护，因守护故，而有执杖、持刀、争吵、争斗、争论、‘你你’之言、离间语、妄语等众多恶不善法生起。”如是所说的九种法以渴爱为根源。其中，“缘于渴爱”即依于渴爱。“寻求”即寻求色等所缘，此唯有在渴爱存在时才会发生。“获得”即获得色等所缘，此唯有在寻求存在时才会发生。“抉择”在此意指寻思。因为获得之后，正是通过寻思来抉择可意与不可意、美好与不美好：“这么多的色所缘将为我所用，这么多的声等所缘将为我所用；这么多将是我的，这么多将是他人的；这么多我将受用，这么多我将储藏。”因此说“缘于获得有抉择”。“欲贪”即通过此等不善寻思，于事物生起弱的贪与强的贪。“欲”在此是弱贪的同义词。“耽著”即“我”与“我所”的坚固认定。“执持”即以渴爱与邪见而执取。“悭吝”即不堪忍与他人共有。因此古人如此解释其词义：“‘愿此妙物唯我独有，勿为他人所有’，因此行相而称为‘悭吝’。”“守护”即通过关门、锁箱等方式妥善守护。‘因由’（adhikaraṇaṃ）一词，因其有‘造成’（adhikaroti）之义，故为‘原因’之名。‘因守护故’（ārakkhādhikaraṇaṃ）是中性抽象名词，意为‘因守护故’。“执杖”等中，为制止他人而持杖为“执杖”；持单刃刀等为“持刀”。“争吵”既有身争吵，也有语争吵。“争斗”是初期的冲突，“争论”是后期的冲突。“‘你你’之言”是不敬之语，意即“你！你！”。
entries.english: “Dependent on craving, there is seeking; dependent on seeking, there is gain; dependent on gain, there is ascertainment; dependent on ascertainment, there is desire and lust; dependent on desire and lust, there is cleaving; dependent on cleaving, there is taking possession; dependent on taking possession, there is stinginess; dependent on stinginess, there is guarding; and on account of guarding, there arise the taking up of rods, the taking up of weapons, quarrels, conflicts, contention, ‘you, you’ speech, slander, and false speech—many such evil, unwholesome states.” Thus, these nine things that have been mentioned, beginning with seeking, are rooted in craving. Therein, “dependent on craving” means relying on craving. “Seeking” is the seeking for sense-objects such as forms. For that arises when craving is present. “Gain” is the acquisition of sense-objects such as forms. For that arises when seeking is present. “Ascertainment”: here, thought is intended. For having obtained a gain, one decides by means of thought alone what is desirable and undesirable, beautiful and ugly, thinking: “This much will be for form-objects, this much for sound-objects and so on, this much will be mine, this much for another, this much I will use, this much I will store away.” Therefore it is said, “dependent on gain, there is ascertainment.” “Desire and lust”: when an object is thought of in this way with unwholesome thought, both weak lust and strong lust arise. For “desire” is here a designation for weak lust. “Cleaving” is the strong conviction “I” and “mine.” “Taking possession” is the act of taking possession by way of craving and wrong view. “Stinginess” is the intolerance of things being common with others. Therefore, the ancients state its etymology thus: “Because it proceeds as ‘Let this wonder be for me alone, let it not be a wonder for another,’ it is called ‘stinginess’.” “Guarding” is thorough protection by way of closing doors, guarding chests, and so on. “It causes” (adhikaroti), thus it is a “cause” (adhikaraṇa); this is a name for a cause. “On account of guarding” (ārakkhādhikaraṇaṃ) is an abstract neuter noun; the meaning is “because of guarding.” In “taking up rods, etc.,” “taking up a rod” is the taking of a rod for the purpose of warding off others. “Taking up a weapon” is the taking of a weapon such as one with a single edge. “Quarrel” is both bodily quarrel and verbal quarrel. The earlier and earlier opposition is a “conflict” (viggaha). The later and later opposition is a “contention” (vivāda). “‘You, you’ speech” (tuvaṃ tuvaṃ) is disrespectful speech; the meaning is “you, you.”

entries.pali: Kāmavitakkabyāpādavitakkavihiṃsāvitakkānaṃ vasena akusalavitakkattayaṃ . Nekkhammavitakkaabyāpādavitakkaavihiṃ sāvitakkānaṃ vasena kusalavitakkattayaṃ . Sabbakilesāpacayabhūtāya vivaṭṭāyā ti rāgādisabbakilesānaṃ apacayahetubhūtāya nibbānadhātuyā. Aṭṭhavīriyārambhavatthupāripūriyā ti aṭṭhannaṃ vīriyārambhakāraṇānaṃ pāripūriyā. Yathā tathā paṭhamaṃ pavattaabbhussahanañhi upari vīriyārambhassa kāraṇaṃ hoti. Anurūpapaccavekkhaṇāsahitāni hi abbhussahanāni tammūlakāni vā paccavekkhaṇāni aṭṭha vīriyārambhavatthūnīti veditabbāni. Tathā hi –
entries.chinese_simplified: 由欲寻思、瞋恚寻思、害寻思，有三不善寻思。由出离寻思、无瞋寻思、无害寻思，有三善寻思。‘为了一切烦恼的灭尽与解脱’是指：为了作为贪等一切烦恼灭尽之因的涅槃界。‘为圆满八种发起精进事’是指：为圆满八种发起精进的因由。正如最初的奋发努力是后来发起精进的原因，应知，与恰当的省察相结合的奋发努力，或以其为根基的省察，即是八种发起精进事。如下所述——
entries.english: By way of sensual thought, thought of ill will, and thought of harm, there is the triad of unwholesome thoughts. By way of thought of renunciation, thought of non-ill will, and thought of non-harm, there is the triad of wholesome thoughts. 'For the turning away which is the destruction of all defilements' means: for the Nibbāna-element, which is the cause for the destruction of all defilements such as lust. 'For the fulfillment of the eight grounds for arousing energy' means: for the fulfillment of the eight causes for arousing energy. For the initial exertion that has arisen in this or that way becomes a cause for the subsequent arousal of energy. Indeed, exertions accompanied by suitable reflection, or reflections rooted in them, should be understood as the eight grounds for arousing energy. Thus:

entries.pali: Chandarāgo ti evaṃ akusalavitakkena vitakkite vatthusmiṃ dubbalarāgo ca balavarāgo ca uppajjati. Ajjhosāna nti ‘‘ahaṃ, mama’’nti balavasanniṭṭhānaṃ. Pariggaho ti taṇhādiṭṭhivasena pariggahakaraṇaṃ. Macchariya nti parehi sādhāraṇabhāvassa asahanatā. Tenevassa porāṇā evaṃ vacanatthaṃ vadanti ‘‘idaṃ acchariyaṃ mayheva hotu, mā aññassa acchariyaṃ hotūti pavattattā macchariyanti vuccatī’’ti. Ārakkho ti dvārapidahanamañjūsāgopanādivasena suṭṭhu rakkhaṇaṃ. Adhi karotīti adhikaraṇaṃ, kāraṇassetaṃ nāmaṃ. Ārakkhādhikaraṇa nti bhāvanapuṃsakaṃ, ārakkhahetūti attho. Daṇḍādānādīsu paranisedhanatthaṃ daṇḍassa ādānaṃ daṇḍādānaṃ . Ekatodhārādino satthassa ādānaṃ satthādānaṃ. Kalaho ti kāyakalahopi vācākalahopi. Purimo purimo virodho viggaho, pacchimo pacchimo vivādo . Tuvaṃ tuvanti agāravavasena ‘‘tuvaṃ tuva’’ nti vacanaṃ.
entries.chinese_simplified: 欲贪(chandarāga)是指以不善寻思(akusalavitakka)思惟所缘境时，生起弱贪(dubbalarāga)与强贪(balavarāga)。执取(ajjhosāna)即‘我’、‘我所’的坚固执著(balavasanniṭṭhāna)。占有(pariggaha)指以渴爱(taṇhā)和邪见(diṭṭhi)为方式的占取行为。悭吝(macchariya)是不堪忍与他人共享。因此古人这样解释它的含义：‘“此奇妙之物(acchariyaṃ)当为我所有，勿为他人所有”，由此而转起，故称为“悭吝”(macchariya)。’守护(ārakkha)是指通过关门、藏在箱子里等方式严密地守护。‘Adhi karoti’故为‘adhikaraṇa’(事端)，此为因缘之名。守护事端(ārakkhādhikaraṇa)是中性抽象词，意思是守护的原因。执杖(daṇḍādāna)等，是指为了阻止他人而拿起棍棒等。执刀(satthādāna)，是指拿起刀剑等武器。斗诤(kalaha)是指身体的争斗和语言的争斗。前者为违逆(virodho)、纷争(viggaho)，后者为争论(vivādo)。‘你你’(tuvaṃ tuvaṃ)是不恭敬的称呼。
entries.english: “Sensual desire” is when, with regard to an object thought of with unwholesome thought, both weak and strong lust arise. “Clinging” is the strong conviction of “I” and “mine.” “Grasping” is the act of taking possession by way of craving and views. “Stinginess” is the inability to bear things being common to others. Therefore, the ancients explain its meaning thus: “Because it proceeds as, ‘Let this wonder be for me; may it not be a wonder for another,’ it is called stinginess.” “Guarding” is thorough protection, such as by closing doors, guarding chests, and so on. “Because it is a cause,” it is a “ground for dispute”; this is a name for a cause. “The ground for guarding” is a neuter abstract noun, meaning “on account of guarding.” “Taking up the rod” is the taking up of a rod for the purpose of warding off others. “Taking up the weapon” is the taking up of a weapon such as a single-edged sword. “Quarrel” is both a physical quarrel and a verbal quarrel. The former is opposition and dispute; the latter is contention. “You, you” is speech by way of disrespect, saying “you, you.”
